blockDom: div.section > div.<name>-wrapper > div.<name>.block[data-block-name][data-block-status]; section gains .<name>-container; default content in div.default-content-wrapper

buttonMapping.bare a alone in p: plain link; blocks wrap it in .link-wrap (prototype .link)

sectionMetadata: server-side (pipeline folds style -> section classes); aem.js has no client-side fold
templateClass: metadata Template -> body class (decorateTemplateAndTheme); React page types use Template | app
chrome: header/footer blocks fetch /nav and /footer (loadFragment); header is a fixed overlay, --nav-height 0
